reviews.text: We recently moved into a log cabin in a wooded area. We have encountered insects, critters, and birds we never had to deal with before in the city. We are confident Dominion is there for us when we need them. Just a phone call away.
reviews.author: Karen M.

reviews.text: Dominion is excellent! Their technician Nelson was incredibly knowledgeable, so very kind and professional, and took care of our problem immediately! Perfection! Thank you so very much for excellent work thank you for caring. We appreciate you.!
reviews.author: Michael G.

reviews.text: I am not currently a customer of Dominion, but when I called them about a concern that I had, they arranged to send out a tech to do a termite inspection two days later. Kasey showed up at the time promised and did a thorough inspection of my house.
reviews.author: william E.
